svg.aria-label: Feynman diagram: p p -> l nu neutralino1 l l neutralino1
svg.font-family: 'NewComputerModern10','New Computer Modern','Latin Modern Roman','CMU Serif','STIX Two Text','Times New Roman',serif
svg.desc: Two protons come in; three charged leptons, a neutrino and two lightest neutralinos go out. The two protons collide, producing a chargino and a second neutralino. The chargino decays into a lightest neutralino and a W boson. The second neutralino decays into a lightest neutralino and a Z boson. The W boson decays into a charged lepton and a neutrino. The Z boson decays into two charged leptons.
